text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring) had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the relocated venue in Hanshin,
I thought the BNW rematch would finally take place, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Geez...!
How'd you end up getting hurt, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! I'm gonna cheer with all my might
for both of you instead-aaaaahhh~~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Have some mercy on the eardrums of everyone around you and keep it down, will you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Taishin.
Looks like we're settling things in a one-on-one duel today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The "winning formula" that I stubbornly
clung to and painstakingly built—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'll show you the fruits of our labor!!
